What We Do

Everything a local business needs to be found — handled in person

We build the website, then make sure real customers can actually find it. Every project starts with a face-to-face visit to your business, not a form on the internet.

🏗️

Custom Website Build

A fast, mobile-friendly site designed around your business — not a generic template that looks like everyone else's.

🚁

Drone & Ground Footage

Aerial shots of your building and location, plus interior/exterior photos and video — all captured on-site by us.

📍

Google & Apple Maps Setup

We claim and optimize your Google Business Profile and Apple Maps listing so customers can find and navigate to you.

🔍

Local SEO

On-page optimization so you show up when Denver customers search for what you do, in your neighborhood.

⭐

Review Generation

QR codes and a simple in-store system that makes it easy for happy customers to leave you a Google review.

📱

Social Profile Setup

Facebook and Instagram business profiles set up and linked to your new site, with consistent branding.

📧

Professional Email

A real @yourbusiness.com email address instead of a personal Gmail — looks sharper on every invoice and card.

🎨

Logo & Basic Branding

Don't have a logo yet? We'll create simple, clean branding — colors, fonts, and a mark you can use everywhere.

🛠️

Hosting & Maintenance

We host the site, keep it secure and updated, and fix things fast if something breaks — no monthly guesswork.

How It Works

Five steps, start to finish

No outsourced strangers, no back-and-forth over email for weeks. We show up, we build it, we keep it running.

1

We meet in person

A free walkthrough of your business — we talk goals, look at your space, and plan the shoot.

2

We shoot photo & drone

Ground and aerial footage of your location, product, or storefront on a day that works for you.

3

We design & build

Your site is built around your brand and your footage — you review drafts before anything goes live.

4

We get you found

Google Business Profile, Apple Maps, and local SEO are set up so customers can actually find you.

5

We stick around

Hosting, updates, and support continue every month — one local point of contact, not a ticket queue.

Why Local Matters

You can meet us. That's the whole point.

Most web design “agencies” are a name on a website with nobody local behind it. Denver Web Crew is different — we're based in Denver, and part of every package is sitting down with you in person.

  • ✓We visit your business to shoot photo and drone footage ourselves — no stock photos.
  • ✓You can call and talk to the person who actually built your site.
  • ✓We know the Denver market — what local customers search for and where they look.
  • ✓Something breaks? We can be at your business, not just on the phone.
